request.style: English, Ghanaian highlife gospel, sweet interlocking guitars, horn riffs, congas and bells, a cheerful male lead and a women's chorus, bouncing and playful, 124 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Jesus came to Jericho
A crowd was all around
Zacchaeus was a little man
He could not see from the ground
He ran ahead and climbed a tree
A sycamore so high
And Jesus stopped and looked up there
And called him from the sky

[Chorus]
Zacchaeus, come down, come down
Today I'm staying at your house
Zacchaeus, come down, come down
Salvation has come to your house

[Verse]
He hurried down with joy that day
The people grumbled loud
Look, Lord, I give half to the poor
And four times what I owe
The Son of Man has come to seek
And save the ones who're lost
Zacchaeus, son of Abraham
Is found at any cost

[Chorus]
Zacchaeus, come down, come down
Today I'm staying at your house
Zacchaeus, come down, come down
Salvation has come to your house
